purpose: Own only the pure numeric composition from already-validated selected-form stat inputs to pre-central legacyValues.

inputContract.statInputs: Caller-supplied verified {ini,up,starCorrection} per hp/at/magic/df/magicDf/dex from an already-selected form.
inputContract.masteryFlats: Caller-supplied frozen Stage4 global mastery totals.
inputContract.normalBondRate: Caller-supplied verified normal-Fetter rate; this composer does not infer Fetter semantics.
inputContract.spBonusRates: Caller-supplied verified per-stat SP bonus rates; omitted stats are zero. Property-ID or description parsing is outside this owner.

formula.roundingBoundary: Normal Fetter and same-stage SP stat bonus are combined before the integer round. Central-bond +5% remains a later separately rounded delta.

leonEvidence.roundingDiscriminator: DEF is 260 when normal +25% and SP +5% are combined before rounding; splitting the SP delta would produce 261.

forbidden: raw ConfigData reads inside the composer
SP relation discovery inside the composer
normal Fetter semantic discovery inside the composer
silent fallback for missing stat inputs or mastery flats
completion: Leon pre-central parity is exact at tolerance 0, the combined normal-Fetter/SP rounding boundary is discriminated, invalid rates fail closed, and no generated/frontend/Stage4/Stage6 files are mutated.
